notes.title: Happy Release Day
notes.notes:
We're live now! 
Join our Developer Release Stream here or on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/byterockersgames]Twitch[/url] and have a Gelly Time together with us!
Yelling, crying and a lot fun are going to be our main focus in this chaotic stream.

notes.title: Gelly Break Deluxe Release Stream
notes.notes:
Hey Gelly friends,

Tomorrow is finally the day: Gelly Break Deluxe will be released on Steam, XBOX, Playstation and the Switch. To celebrate, we invite you to our release stream here on Steam or on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/byterockersgames]Twitch[/url]. We'll talk a bit about the game and celebrate the release with you. Feel free to tune in at 11:00am. We're looking forward to seeing you.

See you tomorrow
Byterockers Games
